notes: Hard via four interdependent sub-problems (9x9 constraint grid, exact big-integer packing count, multi-person+lunch/weekday business-hours slot scan, rotation-invariant neighbour enumeration) unified into a single CLI engine that must generalise to unseen instance directories. The packing instances use 28-32 items (brute-force 2^n infeasible), forcing a no-miss/no-duplicate DP; the unique 9x9 solution, the large exact integer answer, and the exact 9-line grid serialisation all demand quantitative correctness. Hidden cases include edge/malformed instances: capacity 0, a person with a zero-length availability that blocks an entire day, a 1-person and focus-absent round, a lunch break falling before the first usable slot, and a weekend day explicitly in the schedulable list, so the engine must apply every rule simultaneously rather than memorise one visible layout data-dependence. reasoning_depth 3 and dependent_stages 3 (each output depends on a separately specified sub-rule and the whole must be one coherent CLI that generalises).
